name: HiveMind
notes: Voice control: turn it on from the Home screen to run the app by voice in gloves. Say "help" to hear what you can say.
Ask "How old is this queen?" or "What color is she?". Marking her a colour tells you the year it stands for. Each apiary has a Queens' ages list.
During an inspection: "inspect the bottom brood box", "what box are we on?", "what do we have so far, box by box", "scratch that".
Boxes are now numbered from the bottom up (brood box 1 is the bottom one).
Mite counts keep how you counted (wash, sugar roll, sticky board), and many readings are more careful: possible diseases, queen cells, eggs, small hive beetles.
